0/0 runs with every corner at or above it; ; 4 straight runs carry no bend to grade. Rows read drawn/reach — `reach` is the largest radius this run's INTERIOR legs could seat, so a row failing on BOTH is a placement to move and not a number to raise (0 of 0). Reach bounds the centreline only: a run redrawn at it sweeps a wider tube, and lines-clear is what says whether that fits. Each row ends with its NEED — the span its two ends stand apart, split by axis, against the path drawn: a path far over its span rides infrastructure its ends do not ask for, and there the move is the route, not the corner (need.py prints the pack's table, worst first).

poses.name: compressor-shroud
poses.settled: UPRIGHT on the floor slab, centred across the band the cold core opens. Upright is the compressor's own constraint — gravity-fed oil pickup — so the turn is a yaw and the open face points down. The station is settled; the seat, plan register and capture bosses under it are not built yet.

poses.name: condenser+fan
poses.settled: Over the shroud on its 151, airflow axis ACROSS the machine, exhaust face +X at the wall it stands against — the loop's hot end stacked on its own stratum with the band between them the front Z seam's. The block is still a placeholder; its POSE is not.

poses.name: display
poses.settled: Centred on the 45° facet spanning the front-top's full width, let into the top-front corner. The facet is the customer-facing plane of the machine and the glass is centred on it.

poses.name: foam-assembly
poses.settled: The cold core, yawed a quarter turn so its short axis runs across the machine, its bottom cap's lid flat on the floor slab, flush against the seams at the sides and back. The yaw is what buys the full width and the floor is what carries it.

poses.name: hopper-funnel
poses.settled: The basin resting on the top-wall rim ledge directly behind the display facet, its spout on V-B's own column: V-B gates a gravity drain, the one line in this machine that cannot be routed around anything, so the spout's column is the fixed thing and the basin hangs off it. Settled in WHERE IT STANDS. The closed aft-west corner (`hopper_funnel.notch_x` / `notch_y`) is not covered by this: the basin is a customer-facing cast part and a corner taken out of it to clear a fitting clamp is an open defect, `assembly/enclosure-mechanical.md` Open #8.
